flashcards.q: How is prospecting used in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: AI Sales Workflow Integration teaches how to place AI inside each stage of the sales process, from prospecting to closing, so representatives spend more time with buyers and less time on research and administration.

flashcards.q: What does AI Sales Workflow Integration teach about qualification?
flashcards.a: A summary that lists which qualification fields are still unknown tells the representative exactly what to ask next.

flashcards.q: When is prospecting applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: In prospecting, AI researches accounts, finds likely pain points and drafts first outreach.

flashcards.q: When should call not be used in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Research briefs, call summaries and next steps should land on the right account and opportunity, not in a separate tool.

flashcards.q: Which approach to drafts fits AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Then decide which outputs AI drafts and which remain human-only.

flashcards.q: Which uses of objections should be ruled out in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Deal intelligence across the whole pipeline reveals patterns no single representative sees, such as which objections predict a loss or which stakeholder role predicts a win.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with write in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: For each stage, write the inputs, the output and who approves it.

flashcards.q: How is prospecting used in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: A sales workflow is the sequence of steps a deal moves through: prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal, negotiation and close.

flashcards.q: When is drafts applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: In the proposal stage, it drafts sections from approved templates.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with approved in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Outbound emails to new prospects may be approved in batches; pricing, legal terms and commitments always need a human.

flashcards.q: How is repetitive used in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Each step has repetitive work that AI can speed up.

flashcards.q: When is call applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Account research combines public information, such as company news and job postings, with internal data, such as past conversations, into a short brief before each call.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with prospects in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Letting AI write to prospects with invented facts destroys trust.

flashcards.q: How is AI-assisted version used in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Document the current steps and time spent, design the AI-assisted version with clear human approval points, run it on ten real deals and compare time and outcomes.

flashcards.q: When is objections applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: Call intelligence tools record and transcribe calls, then extract next steps, objections, competitors mentioned and buying signals.

flashcards.q: When is write applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: For each stage, write the inputs, the output and who approves it.

flashcards.q: When is representative applied in AI Sales Workflow Integration?
flashcards.a: When research and administration shrink, each representative can manage more accounts at higher quality, which changes territory design and hiring plans.
